segments.comment: Independent wizard-mode death to a kobold mummy on a new level 3, answering yes to Save bones. A variation on the ghoul recipe: a gnome killed by a mummy rises as a gnome mummy, so bones.c savebones() also reaches its mummy-wrapping branch (makemon.c mongets()) before worn.c m_dowear() dresses the new mummy. A second game on a new seed and clock goes to level 3 and loads that bones file (bones.c getbones()), so the risen mummy and its inventory round-trip. The seeds, clocks, character, and input were chosen for this path.
